seoTitle: How to Change the Font in Freshdesk
metaDescription: Set the default font and size agents compose replies in, under Admin > Account > Helpdesk Settings in Freshdesk, and decide whether agents can override it.
intro:
When people ask how to change the font in Freshdesk, they usually mean the font agents type in while replying to tickets. That lives in one place: the Agent portal default font preference, on the Helpdesk Settings page in Admin. It sets a default typeface and size for the whole team, and a second toggle decides whether each agent may pick their own.

The customer-facing help center has separate font controls under Portals. This guide covers the agent side first, then points to the portal option at the end so you don't change the wrong one.
prerequisites: An admin role in Freshdesk. Helpdesk Settings sits inside the Admin area, which agents without admin access cannot open.

steps.heading: Open Admin from the ticket view
steps.body: Sign in and you land on All tickets, the list agents work from all day. There's no font control here. Click the gear icon in the left sidebar to open Admin.

image.caption: The All tickets list, where the agent sidebar holds the gear icon that opens Admin.

steps.heading: Go to Account > Helpdesk Settings
steps.body:
Admin is split into sections such as Freddy, Team, Channels, Workflows, Agent Productivity, Support Operations and Account. The font preference isn't under Team or Channels. Scroll down to Account and open Helpdesk Settings; Freshdesk's own documentation gives the path as Admin > Account > Helpdesk Settings.

This is one long page. It also holds the helpdesk name and URL, date format and time zone, the next ticket ID, ticket view layout and branding, so expect to scroll. On a slow connection the page can sit blank for a moment before its fields load.

image.caption: The Admin panel, grouped into Freddy, Team, Channels, Support Operations and Account.

steps.heading: Pick the default font and size
steps.body:
Find Agent portal default font preference. The Default font dropdown starts on System and lists the typefaces Freshdesk offers. Under it, the Font size dropdown runs from 10px to 20px and renders the sample line "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" at each size as you hover, so you can judge it before choosing.

Pick something an agent can read for a whole shift. Very small sizes tire the eyes over hundreds of replies. Very large ones push the reply box's content off screen.

image.caption: The Font size dropdown under Agent portal default font preference, previewing each size against a sample sentence.

steps.heading: Choose whether agents can override it, then click Save
steps.body:
Below the size picker is Font preference for agents. With it on, each agent can change font style and size while composing messages and replies. Leave it off if you want every reply to look the same no matter who wrote it.

The dropdowns do not save themselves. Click Save at the bottom of the page, as Freshdesk's documentation instructs. Then open any ticket, start a reply and check that the compose box shows the new font.

troubleshooting.problem: The font went back to the old one after leaving the page
troubleshooting.cause: Helpdesk Settings needs an explicit Save. Changing a dropdown alone does not store it.
troubleshooting.fix: Reopen Admin > Account > Helpdesk Settings, set the font and size again and click Save before navigating away.

troubleshooting.problem: The help center your customers visit still uses the old font
troubleshooting.cause: The agent portal font preference only affects the agent side. The customer portal is styled separately.
troubleshooting.fix: Go to Admin > Portals, edit the portal, open the Appearance tab, choose Customize portal and change the fonts under Portal Fonts. Freshdesk restricts portal theme customization by plan, so check the portal article linked below if the option is missing.

troubleshooting.problem: An agent's compose box doesn't match the new default
troubleshooting.cause: Font preference for agents is switched on, and that agent has chosen their own style or size.
troubleshooting.fix: Either ask the agent to switch back, or turn the toggle off and save so the account default applies to everyone.

faq.question: Where is the font setting in Freshdesk?
faq.answer: Admin > Account > Helpdesk Settings, under Agent portal default font preference. It isn't in the Team or Channels sections.

faq.question: Does this change the font customers see on the support portal?
faq.answer: No. It sets the font in the agent portal while composing. The customer help center has its own Portal Fonts option under Admin > Portals > Appearance > Customize portal.

faq.question: What font sizes are available?
faq.answer: The Font size dropdown goes from 10px to 20px, with a sample sentence previewed at each size.

faq.question: Can each agent use a different font?
faq.answer: Only when Font preference for agents is enabled. That lets individual agents change font style and size while writing messages and replies.
